decisive_passage: 1.5 **"Owner Payment Condition"** means Contractor's actual receipt of payment from Owner for the Subcontract Work covered by a given Payment Application. Contractor's actual receipt of that payment from Owner is an express condition precedent to any obligation of Contractor to pay Subcontractor, and Subcontractor assumes the risk of Owner nonpayment. The parties have expressly agreed in writing to this condition by signing this Subcontract.
